which_endpoint: OS (joint analysis of MILES-3 and MILES-4)
search_notes: ASCO 2017 abstract 9002 (Gridelli et al., names NCT01405586 and NCT01656551), read through the Crossref record of the abstract DOI because ascopubs.org returns 403; dated by the JCO supplement issue date 20 May 2017 (ASCO put 2017 abstracts online about 17 May; oral session 2-6 June 2017). MILES-3 (299 pts) and MILES-4 were both closed early for slow accrual and analysed jointly on IDMC advice: with/without cisplatin median OS 9.6 vs 7.5 mo, HR 0.86 (0.70-1.04), p=0.14, 384 deaths. No MILES-3-only primary analysis exists, so this could be argued as terminated_no_analysis. JCO paper epub 2018-07-20 (PMID 30028656). Registry still carries an estimated primary completion of 2024-11 (status unknown), 7.5 years after the readout.

which_endpoint: OS (platform trial: SM-88 arm dropped for futility 2022; pamrevlumab arm not met 2024)
search_notes: PLATFORM TRIAL WITH TWO ARM-LEVEL READOUTS, both negative on OS. (1) TYME press release of 26 Jan 2022 (Business Wire, read via a Stock Titan copy): PanCAN terminated the SM-88 arm "due to futility" on the primary endpoint of OS in second-line patients; no numbers. This arm was dropped in stage 1 and never reached the phase 3 stage. (2) FibroGen press release of 30 July 2024 (read via OncLive, dated 31 July): pamrevlumab + gem/nab-paclitaxel arm, which graduated to stage 2, did not meet OS; Bayesian model HR 1.170 (95% credible interval 0.882-1.563), posterior probability 0.14. HR COLUMNS ARE FOR THE PAMREVLUMAB ARM. If the trial is to be scored on its phase 3 (pamrevlumab) comparison, first disclosure is 2024-07-30 with HR in the first disclosure (lag -190 days). Full data at ASCO GI 2025 (abstract 673: HR 1.18, 0.88-1.56). Registry lists a third experimental arm (canakinumab + spartalizumab) for which no result was found. Registry PCD 2025-02-05 actual, no results posted.
